From 464af6fc2b1dcc74005b7f58ee3812b17777efee Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Paolo Bonzini <pbonzini@redhat.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Apr 2026 14:25:40 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] KVM: x86: check for nEPT/nNPT in slow flush hypercalls

Checking is_guest_mode(vcpu) is incorrect, because translate_nested_gpa()
is only valid if an L2 guest is running *with nested EPT/NPT enabled*.
Instead use the same condition as translate_nested_gpa() itself.

Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org
Reviewed-by: Sean Christopherson <seanjc@google.com>
Fixes: aee738236dca ("KVM: x86: Prepare kvm_hv_flush_tlb() to handle L2's GPAs", 2022-11-18)
Link: https://patch.msgid.link/20260503200905.106077-1-pbonzini@redhat.com/
Signed-off-by: Paolo Bonzini <pbonzini@redhat.com>

diff --git a/arch/x86/kvm/hyperv.c b/arch/x86/kvm/hyperv.c
index 9b140bbdc1d8..4438ecac9a89 100644
--- a/arch/x86/kvm/hyperv.c
+++ b/arch/x86/kvm/hyperv.c
@@ -2040,7 +2040,7 @@ static u64 kvm_hv_flush_tlb(struct kvm_vcpu *vcpu, struct kvm_hv_hcall *hc)
 	 * flush).  Translate the address here so the memory can be uniformly
 	 * read with kvm_read_guest().
 	 */
-	if (!hc->fast && is_guest_mode(vcpu)) {
+	if (!hc->fast && mmu_is_nested(vcpu)) {
 		hc->ingpa = translate_nested_gpa(vcpu, hc->ingpa, 0, NULL);
 		if (unlikely(hc->ingpa == INVALID_GPA))
 			return HV_STATUS_INVALID_HYPERCALL_INPUT;
-- 
2.34.1

### Summary of Modifications

The patch modifies a single file: `arch/x86/kvm/hyperv.c`.

**File: `arch/x86/kvm/hyperv.c`**
- In function `kvm_hv_flush_tlb`, the condition for translating the hypercall input GPA from L2 to L1 was changed from `is_guest_mode(vcpu)` to `mmu_is_nested(vcpu)`.

### Relationships

The change ensures that GPA translation (via `translate_nested_gpa()`) is only performed when nested EPT/NPT is actually enabled for the L2 guest, rather than merely relying on whether L2 is running (`is_guest_mode`). This aligns the condition with the internal check used by `translate_nested_gpa()` itself, preventing incorrect translation attempts that could lead to invalid hypercall handling.

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```
if (!hc->fast && is_guest_mode(vcpu)) {
```
Reason:  
`is_guest_mode(vcpu)` returns `true` whenever L2 is running, regardless of whether nested EPT/NPT is enabled. `translate_nested_gpa()` is only valid when nested paging (EPT/NPT) is active; calling it under shadow paging causes incorrect GPA translation or invalid hypercall behavior.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```
if (!hc->fast && mmu_is_nested(vcpu)) {
```
Reason:  
`mmu_is_nested(vcpu)` checks whether the nested MMU is active (i.e., nested EPT/NPT is enabled), which matches the precondition required by `translate_nested_gpa()`. This ensures the translation is only applied when it is actually valid, fixing the bug.
